title: The chart parks and their claim lands beside it

members.role: the ledger page mounts on the cream and is never cut away
the page-species carrier for all five verbs above
park the held chart so the card lands beside it; un-park when it leaves
THEIR claim, masthead + underlined phrase, in place of the badge rail
the press pile - R4's pulse applied to external claims
the sourced crawl under a surface that shows who said it

does: Our chart stays on stage and makes room: it shrinks to its own corner, their headline pile lands in the space it left with the wire crawling under it, and the chart grows back when they leave.
